messages.author: 66a7bbbceef834e9
messages.subject: Re: Is this a bug in ggplot2 or am I doing something wrong
parts:
I believe this is a bug in ggplot. The bars extend to the other categories when they are NA. Here's a workaround filling the NA with 0.

library(ggplot2)
dat <-read.csv("http://dl.dropbox.com/u/389960/x.csv", head=T)
attach(dat)
ggplot(dat,aes(xyz,Plan,na.rm=T,FUN=sum),Plan,fill=State) +
facet_wrap(~State,nrow=1) + geom_bar(stat="identity", width = 0.2 ) + coord_flip()

dat2 <- reshape(dat, idvar = "xyz", timevar = "State", direction = "wide")

dat2[is.na(dat2)] <- 0

dat3 <- reshape(dat2, idvar = "xyz", varying = grep("Plan", names(dat2)), 
                direction = "long")
names(dat3)[2] <- "State"
ggplot(dat3,aes(xyz,Plan,na.rm=T,FUN=sum),Plan,fill=State) +
facet_wrap(~State,nrow=1) + geom_bar(stat="identity", width = 0.2 )+
coord_flip()

HTH

Luciano
